kill_chain_signals.contact: Traffic to fake websites generated through paid advertisements on social media platforms like Facebook and Instagram
kill_chain_signals.pretext: Fraudsters pose as buyers sending overpayments or as sellers collecting payment, or create fake websites with limited time offers
kill_chain_signals.payment: Seller refunds difference after overpayment, or buyer sends payment for non-existent merchandise
kill_chain_signals.movement: Original payment bounces or is reversed after seller has refunded the difference

red_flags: Blowout sales or greatly reduced prices (e.g. 80% off)
Text with spelling errors or references to the product as 'the item'
Overseas buyers who want to make a purchase without seeing the product first
Overpayments for items you are selling
Sellers with recently created social media profiles
key_quote: Taking a few extra seconds to pause and verify can save you from losing money and personal information.
title: Check twice, pay once: starting new habits to avoid merchandise fraud
